reference_lines.label: EU RFNBO threshold (70 % below 94 g CO2e/MJ)
reference_lines.source: eu2023_1185, Annex, fossil fuel comparator; RED Art. 25(2) 70 % saving
reference_lines.note: Threshold = 94 x (1 - 0.70) g/MJ x LHV(H2) = approx. 3.38 kg CO2e/kg H2 (computed in code from amcrax.schemas.LHV_KJ_PER_MOL). The EU boundary is well-to-wheel incl. delivery, broader than AmCraX's: comparison is indicative only.

reference_lines.label: IEA low-emission H2 (as quoted by Kum et al.)
reference_lines.source: kum2026heatintegrated, p. 17, Sec. 4.7, citing IEA Global Hydrogen Review 2024 (ref. [52])
reference_lines.note: 'H2 with a total carbon intensity below 4 kg CO2/kg H2 is regarded as low-emission H2' (as quoted by Kum et al.).

notes: Simplified carbon-intensity accounting (activity x emission factor); NOT a life-cycle assessment.
Input simulation source: aspen_plus_v15.
Self-firing: extra NH3 burnt for the heat deficit; its upstream and transport emissions are booked under external_heat. NH3/tail-gas combustion N2O and NOx are outside the model.
Electricity covers the feed pump only (plus electric heating if chosen); PSA/compressor power is not in the simulation result and is therefore not counted.

grey/electric.method: Simplified carbon-intensity accounting (activity x emission factor); NOT a life-cycle assessment.
grey/electric.system_boundary: Cradle-to-gate of H2 at the cracker/PSA outlet: upstream NH3 production, NH3 sea transport, process electricity, external heat supply. Excluded: plant construction and equipment manufacture, catalyst/adsorbent manufacture, N2O/NOx/NH3 slip from tail-gas or NH3 combustion, H2 leakage, H2 compression/storage/delivery, NH3 boil-off, upstream natural-gas supply chain.

factors.name: upstream_ammonia.grey
factors.source: lee2022ammonia, p. 13, LCA results; Fig. 8 (conventional NG-based NH3, WTG)
factors.note: Natural-gas SMR + Haber-Bosch, no capture. Within the range in kum2026heatintegrated p. 17 (gray NH3 approx. 2.6) and cechetto2023membrane p. 19 (2.0-4.6 t CO2/t NH3).

factors.name: transport.ship_ef
factors.source: glec2023v3, Liquefied gas tanker 100000-199999 cbm, VLSFO, WTW (via Climatiq listing)
factors.note: Generic liquefied-gas carrier on fossil fuel oil; not ammonia-specific (no ammonia-tanker value was found). Applies per tonne of NH3 cargo.

factors.name: transport.distance_km
factors.note: ASSUMPTION: illustrative one-way sea distance for imported NH3 (order of magnitude of intra-Asia-Pacific / Middle-East-to-Asia voyages). Override with distance_km=...; set 0 to exclude transport. Boil-off and port handling are not counted.

factors.name: electricity.singapore_2024
factors.source: ema2025ses, Singapore Energy Statistics Ch. 2, average Grid Emission Factor 2024 (0.412 in 2023)
factors.note: Operating-margin average of grid-connected generation (combustion CO2). Default grid.

factors.name: heating.electric_heater_efficiency
factors.note: ASSUMPTION: resistive electric heating converts electricity to process heat with efficiency 1 (first-law ideal).
